User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the Career360 platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

testsCompleted.description: The number of tests completed by the user.

profileStrength.description: A numerical representation of the user's profile completeness or strength.

resumeFile.description: Reference to the resume file stored in Firebase Storage. (Relationship: User 1:1 Resume)

TestResult.title: TestResult
TestResult.description: Stores the results of a career assessment test taken by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the test result entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who took the test. (Relationship: User 1:N TestResult)

scores.description: Scores on the aptitude, personality and interest factors.

recommendedCareers.description: An array of career recommendations based on the test results.

timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the test was completed.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents a single message within a chat session between a user and the AI assistant.

id.description: Unique identifier for the message entity.

chatSessionId.description: The chat session this message belongs to.

sender.description: Indicates who sent the message ('user' or 'assistant').

message.description: The content of the chat message.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the message was sent.

ResumeAnalysis.title: ResumeAnalysis
ResumeAnalysis.description: Stores the analysis results of a user's resume.

id.description: Unique identifier for the resume analysis entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User whose resume was analyzed. (Relationship: User 1:1 ResumeAnalysis)

skills.description: An array of skills identified in the resume.

atsScore.description: The ATS (Applicant Tracking System) score of the resume.

missingSkills.description: An array of skills missing from the resume.

generatedResume.description: Reference to the generated resume file (if any) in Firebase Storage.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the resume analysis was performed.

AdminSettings.title: AdminSettings
AdminSettings.description: Stores system-wide settings managed by the administrator.

id.description: Unique identifier for the settings entity.  Should always be 'system'.

bannedWords.description: An array of words that are banned from being used in the chat or resume.

aiLimits.description: Limits for AI usage, such as maximum chats per day.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to provide a secure and scalable backend for the Career360 platform, focusing on authorization independence, clarity, and predictable data access patterns.  Path-based ownership secures user-specific data, while membership maps are used for collaborative content.  Denormalization of authorization data is employed to eliminate the need for `get()` calls in security rules, crucial for atomic operations and debuggability.

The structure ensures QAPs by:

*   Segregating data based on access requirements (e.g., user-owned data under `/users/{userId}`).
*   Using dedicated collections for global roles (`/roles_admin/{uid}`) for secure `list` operations.  The design avoids custom claims, relying solely on `request.auth.uid` and data stored in the database.

To support invariants, the structure enforces strict naming conventions, explicit state modeling with a `status` field, and predictable schema to ensure data integrity and consistency.
